name: FirstCut
tagline: FirstCut is an AI video editor for action camera, drone, and travel footage
description: FirstCut is an AI video editor for action camera, drone, and travel footage. Upload a folder of raw clips and it analyzes each one, selects the strongest moments, and assembles them into a music-synced highlight reel with beat-aligned cuts. It handles clip selection, sequencing, timing, and music sync automatically, so you get a shareable video without manual editing. Built for drone pilots, travel creators, and action-cam shooters who shoot more than they edit.
